text:
Sam (PM): quick sync: customers want a single flow to go from \"cost blips\" -> sample traces -> error fingerprints. aim to scope an MVP for the next two sprints.
Priya (Eng): agreed. propose a tiny surface: a dashboard heatmap (route x hour) + drilldown to sampled traces + error fingerprint links. keep data joins lightweight.
Ethan (SRE): sampling rules need to be dynamic. if a route spikes we should switch to header-only mode automatically. otherwise we risk storage bills.
Lina (CS): couple of customers specifically asked for per-call context (op_id) so support can replay and reconcile cost. that's high-impact for renewals.
Sam (PM): MVP checklist (draft):
- heatmap: cost by route/time (24h, 7d)
- drilldown: aggregated per-call metrics + link to sampled traces
- error fingerprints tied to traces and recent logs
- feature flagged canary rollout
Priya (Eng): tech constraints: to join cost->trace we need a consistent op_id propagated from frontends through the runtime. adding X-Op-Id header is simplest. estimate: 2 devs x 2 weeks to wire, 1 week infra rollout.
Ethan (SRE): runtime guardrails: default sample rate 0.5% globally; per-route override via config; runtime throttle kicks in if ingest > 4000 spans/min. telemetry-bot: ALERT RULE CREATED: trace-ingest-rate > 4000 spans/min.
Lina (CS): ask: can we include a CSV export with per-call rows for canary customers? they want to run their own FinOps joins.
Sam (PM): include CSV export for canary only. full export later.
Priya (Eng): data schema proposal for events: [\"ts\", \"route\", \"op_id\", \"deployment\", \"cost_usd\", \"trace_id_opt\"]. lightweight and back-compatible.
Ethan (SRE): observability SLOs we should agree on: dashboard tile render p95 < 1.8s, heatmap fetch < 2.5s for 7d query, sampling overhead p95 < 0.8ms.
Sam (PM): sounds reasonable. callout: UX must surface \"why cost spiked\" in one click (top routes, top models, top errors).
Priya (Eng): prototype snippet for header propagation:
```
// middleware pseudocode
if (!request.headers['X-Op-Id']) request.headers['X-Op-Id'] = generate_op_id();
context.op_id = request.headers['X-Op-Id'];
// attach to outgoing model call
model_call.metadata['op_id'] = context.op_id;
```
Lina (CS): timeline preference from customers: fastest visibility wins. prioritize heatmap + CSV before deep trace UI.
Sam (PM): priority order updated: 1) heatmap + CSV for canary, 2) sampled traces + trace links, 3) error fingerprint integration.
Ethan (SRE): rollout plan: stage 1 internal + partner canary (2 customers) for 3 weeks. stage 2 widen to paid tenants if no ingest alarms. revert flag ready.
Priya (Eng): risks: missing op_id on older SDKs. mitigation: SDK patch + a server-side fallback that synthesizes op_id but marks as sampled-synth. will include migration plan.
Sam (PM): acceptance criteria before GA:
- canary heatmap shows accurate cost deltas vs billing (within 3%)
- CSV export contains op_id and cost rows for sample set
- trace sample rate respected and throttled when needed
- rollback via feature flag within 15m
Ethan (SRE): add: dashboard shows live ingest rate and will auto-flip to header-only traces when throttled.
Priya (Eng): effort summary requested: I'll post estimates by EOD.
telemetry-bot: NOTE: schema-migration-job scheduled 2026-04-02 04:00 UTC.
Lina (CS): quick sales blurb request: one sentence that explains ROI for FinOps teams. Sam, can you draft?
Sam (PM): draft: \"See cost hot spots end-to-end: heatmap to sampled traces so FinOps and Support can find and resolve expensive calls quickly.\"
Lina (CS): nice, will pass to AE team.
Sam (PM): thanks everyone. I'll turn this into tickets and link back here. if Priya posts estimates, we'll triage into the next sprint planning.
